escena: SCENE (cinematic, a real SIX-SECOND long-exposure photograph taken on a tripod in a dark film studio at night, during the shooting of a short product ad): a Latin American art director in his late thirties, short dark hair and a trimmed beard, wearing the Efeonce hoodie exactly as in its reference, stands perfectly still and SHARP slightly RIGHT of center in the lower part of the frame, framed from the waist up, looking straight into the lens with calm, exacting focus, both arms relaxed at his sides. In front of him and to the LEFT, on a slim matte black stand at chest height, sits a fictitious faceted glass perfume bottle with NO label and NO lettering, perfectly still and razor sharp. During the six seconds a light on a motion-control arm traced the planned camera move of the ad: ONE single clean, continuous vivid orange (#FF6500) light trail that enters from the deep background on the left, glides forward in one smooth decisive curve and ENDS exactly on the main specular highlight of the bottle, where it ignites a brilliant pinpoint of light. The trail never circles him: it goes to the product. Two crew members who walked behind him during the exposure are soft translucent ghosts with long blur; a camera dolly in the far background is a smear of dark motion. LIGHT: the trail and the ignited highlight are the brightest elements of the frame and the only key light: they paint the bottle and the near side of his face warm orange, the far side of his face in shadow, NO fill light. A cool azure (#0375DB) rim light from behind outlines his head and shoulders. Thin haze catches the trail. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm, nothing foreshortened, he does not lean toward the lens. Real long-exposure physics: genuine motion blur, real sensor grain, fine dust in the haze, slight chromatic aberration on the brightest edges. GEOGRAPHY: the trail and the bottle stay below 34% of the frame height; the TOP 30% of the frame is calm, deep dark studio space with only faint haze, no trail, no light, no objects. Enormous contrast, deep navy blacks. No readable text, no letters, no logos of any brand.

lecho.objeto: the near-black matte edge of a director's monitor cart close to the lens across the whole bottom of the frame, completely out of focus, outside every light and every reflection

texto.muro: calm, deep dark studio space with only faint haze
